## berth org use

a default org, for org commands that leave it out (berth up, berth fw show, …)

### Synopsis

Saves a default org (on this machine, or on a registered host). Org commands take it when their org is
left out: berth up, berth fw show, berth repo add owner/repo. A mistyped org is an error, never replaced by the
default. With no argument, shows it.

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_org_use/

```
berth org use [<org>[@host]] | --clear [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth org use acme@box1
  berth org use
  berth org use --clear
```
